description: This file defines the 'LocalDispatcher' interface, which serves as the main API for the service engine in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes method signatures for running services synchronously and asynchronously, scheduling jobs, managing callbacks, and accessing related components like JobManager, Delegator, Security, and JMS Listener Factory.

classes.name: LocalDispatcher
classes.description: An interface providing methods for service execution, scheduling, callback registration, and component access within the OFBiz service engine.

methods.name: disableEcas
methods.description: Disables running of Service Engine Condition Actions (SECAs).

methods.name: enableEcas
methods.description: Reenables running of Service Engine Condition Actions (SECAs).

methods.name: isEcasDisabled
methods.description: Checks if SECAs are disabled.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously and returns the result.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously with a timeout and transaction control.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously, ignoring the result.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously with timeout, ignoring the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously, passing a requester for the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with transaction control.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously, passing a requester.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously, passing a requester, with persistence option.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously, with persistence.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously, ignoring the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously, ignoring the result, with persistence.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously, ignoring the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously, ignoring the result, with persistence.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously and waits for the result, returning a waiter object.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with persistence and waits for the result.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously and waits for the result.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with persistence and waits for the result.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback listener for a specific service.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a service to run asynchronously at a specific time with recurrence options.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a job with a specific job name and recurrence options.

methods.name: addRollbackService
methods.description: Adds a rollback service to the current transaction.

methods.name: addRollbackService
methods.description: Adds a rollback service with persistence control.

methods.name: addCommitService
methods.description: Adds a commit service to the current transaction.

methods.name: addCommitService
methods.description: Adds a commit service with persistence control.

methods.name: getJobManager
methods.description: Returns the JobManager associated with this dispatcher.

methods.name: getJMSListeneFactory
methods.description: Returns the JmsListenerFactory managing message listeners.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator associated with this dispatcher.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Returns the Security object associated with this dispatcher.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this local dispatcher.

methods.name: getDispatchContext
methods.description: Returns the DispatchContext created by this dispatcher.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: De-registers this LocalDispatcher.
